items.title_en: Male Fugitive Avoids Capture for 8 Years by Changing Gender and Living as a Woman
items.title_zh: 男性逃亡者通过改变性别并以女性身份生活，避免被捕 8 年
items.summary_en: Tuğrul Başar had been convicted of three robbery crimes committed while impersonating a public official in 2010, but had managed to escape in 2018 to avoid a three-year prison sentence. Authorities had been looking for him ever since, but they only recently managed to identify him in the Kadıköy district of Istanbul, during a special operation designed to bring fugitives with unserved prison sentences to justice. What made Başar’s case stand out from others resolved during the special operation was the shocking…
items.summary_zh: 图鲁尔·巴萨尔 (Tuğrul Başar) 于 2010 年因冒充公职人员犯下三起抢劫罪被定罪，但于 2018 年成功越狱，避免了三年监禁。从那时起，当局就一直在寻找他，但直到最近，他们才在伊斯坦布尔卡德柯伊区的一次特别行动中找到了他的身份，该行动旨在将未服刑的逃犯绳之以法。是什么让巴沙尔的案件从其他案件中脱颖而出？
